paragraphs: Rav Hamnuna son of Rava of Pashrunya: Gittin 45b.
Rav Chinena son of Rava of Pashrunya: Pesachim 76a.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The William Davidson digital text of Pesachim 76a fully writes Rav Chinena son of Rava of Pashrunya. This supports Rav for the abbreviation ר׳ in the second notice; the first notice remains separate.

The whole Davidson Gittin 45b paragraph fully names Rav Hamnuna son of Rava of Pashrunya; the whole Pesachim 76a paragraph fully names Rav Chinena son of Rava of Pashrunya. The local titles, including Rav for the second abbreviation, are supported as in the retained note. The notices remain separate without establishing a common father.
